# derivation product

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:derivationProduct`](gmeow-derivationProduct.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/derivationProduct>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The product creative work that was derived from the source. Functional per relator: one product per [`CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md).

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) -> [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:derivationProduct`](gmeow-derivationProduct.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) to [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md), [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use inside a [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) to name the single product work that resulted from the derivation, at the honest tier (a new [`Expression`](../classes/gmeow-Expression.md) for a cover, a new [`Recording`](../classes/gmeow-Recording.md) for a remix).

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it outside a [`CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) relator and avoid more than one product — it is functional.

### How to use

- Point the [`CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) at one product [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md); pair with [`gmeow:derivationSource`](gmeow-derivationSource.md) and [`gmeow:derivationType`](gmeow-derivationType.md).
